title: Azure AI Foundry connection service
description: Service-level configuration for a host: azure.ai.connection entry. The service key is the connection name. azd updates or creates the connection on the project the entry depends on.

name.description: Connection name. Required in a standalone connection definition; the azure.yaml service key supplies it when composed.

target.description: Target endpoint URL or ARM resource ID. May contain ${VAR}; declare each referenced variable in the service-level env object.

credentials.description: Credentials. Use ${VAR} for azd service env substitution or ${{...}} for Foundry server-side resolution. In a service env value, use $${{...}} so azd forwards the Foundry expression unchanged.

audience.description: Token audience for user, project-managed, or agentic identity authentication.

connectorName.description: Managed connector name for an OAuth2 connection.
